responsibility: This file implements an AArch64 RTL loop pass for Qualcomm Falkor that reduces hardware-prefetch tag collisions among loads by selectively renaming destination registers. It analyzes loads inside loops, computes Falkor-specific prefetch tags from destination register, base register, and encoded offset, groups colliding loads in tag-indexed maps, uses regrename and def-use chain information to discard redundant same-chain cases, and then renames loads to spread unrelated accesses across different tags while preserving legality. The pass is exposed as make_pass_tag_collision_avoidance and is enabled by the Falkor load-register renaming tuning flag.
